steps.title: 感測選擇：模型與設計
steps.objective: 針對「感測選擇」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for sensor selection.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「感測選擇」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。分流器與 CT 具有不同隔離及頻響。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「比較負載、頻率及相位誤差。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for sensor selection, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Shunts and CTs differ in isolation and frequency response. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Compare loading, bandwidth and phase error. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 比較負載、頻率及相位誤差。
steps.observationEn: Compare loading, bandwidth and phase error.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「感測選擇」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping sensor selection verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「感測選擇」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「比較負載、頻率及相位誤差。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for sensor selection; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 分流器與 CT 具有不同隔離及頻響。
knowledge.textEn: Shunts and CTs differ in isolation and frequency response.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 比較負載、頻率及相位誤差。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Compare loading, bandwidth and phase error. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假設正弦 230 V RMS、10 A RMS、功率因數 0.8，P=VI cosφ=1840 W，2 h 電能 3.68 kWh。若電壓、電流各有獨立 0.1% 相對標準不確定度且相位準確，功率約 0.141%（未含其他項）。

summary: 以同步取樣、功率積分與計量不確定度串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect synchronous sampling, power integration and metrology uncertainty through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.
